reusable_obstruction_or_lesson.falsifier: A fallback-aware legal four-pair G17 cover would refute the stronger interpretation that the fallback itself obstructs constant cover; the present lesson only requires exact support typing.
reusable_obstruction_or_lesson.statement: Before routing on a distinguished semantic/canonical decoder family, enumerate and type every exceptional decoder branch that contributes to the actual mathematical object. Here the deterministic all-zero contradiction gives a row-zero fallback edge at every extension, so 'first row collision' is ill-posed unless the fallback is first proved cover-neutral or explicitly normalized.
